scope.policy: This is source evidence, not a live deployment. A candidate remains review_required unless the programme-specific curriculum and external source establish the relationship at the required scope.

local_evidence.locator: programmes[name=Mathematics]; STA 112, COS 201, MTH 209, MTH 308, MTH 407 and MTH 408
local_evidence.summary: The CCMAS Mathematics programme includes probability, computer programming, numerical analysis, mathematical modelling and mathematical methods.

sources.title: University of Jos Department of Mathematics
sources.locator: Lines 19-23 identify undergraduate Mathematics and list computational mathematics, mathematical modelling, statistical modelling and Data Science among the department's research interests; lines 42-49 describe applied mathematical/statistical and data-analysis preparation.
sources.evidence: Authoritative Nigerian university context corroborates a Mathematics-to-Data-Science pathway, but the page describes department research and programme objectives rather than a named undergraduate Data Science track.

sources.title: University of Ibadan Department of Mathematics course list
sources.locator: Lines 126-137 list Probability I, Introduction to Computer Sciences and optional Statistical Inference; lines 148-181 list Computer Programming, Numerical Analysis, Statistical Inference, Programming and Algorithms and Scientific Programming.
sources.evidence: A second official Nigerian Mathematics curriculum corroborates the quantitative and computational anchors used by the local CCMAS row.

sources.title: Skyline University Nigeria B.Sc. Data Science
sources.locator: Lines 127-142 define the target programme through mathematics, statistics, programming, optimization and data-analytics workflows.
sources.evidence: Target-domain definition only; it is not used to claim that every Mathematics graduate is a Data Scientist.

records.limitation: The local CCMAS outcomes do not explicitly name Data Science, so this remains a source-backed candidate for review rather than an active student-facing link.

sources.title: University of Jos Department of Mathematics

records.limitation: The named JAMB row is not a separate full CCMAS programme; it remains partial and must not be presented as a complete Data Science curriculum.

local_evidence.locator: programmes[name=Mathematics]; STA 112 Probability I and the general MTH sequence

sources.title: University of Ibadan Department of Mathematics course list

sources.evidence: This is an elective signal, not proof of an actuarial programme relationship.

sources.title: Ahmadu Bello University Actuarial Science undergraduate programme
sources.locator: Lines 103-116 list Numerical Analysis, Actuarial Mathematics and Theory of Interest, Mathematical Statistics, Probability Theory and Operations Research; lines 131-147 list Life Contingencies, Actuarial Statistics and Mortality Analysis, Risk Theory and Management and related insurance courses.
sources.evidence: Defines the target domain's distinct actuarial curriculum and shows why the Mathematics row alone is insufficient.

records.limitation: Retain review_required; do not infer Actuarial Science from general probability or one elective course.

sources.title: Ahmadu Bello University Actuarial Science undergraduate programme
sources.evidence: The official Actuarial Science curriculum names the matching numerical, probability, actuarial mathematics, mortality, investment and risk subjects.

records.limitation: The component-level evidence is strong, but the JAMB row remains review_required in the canonical inheritance artifact; no generated row is rewritten here.

unresolved_queue_policy.action: Keep all unreviewed rows review_required; do not fill missing curriculum, relationship, URL or locator fields with inference.
